project.name: VentuSample
native_surfaces: Qt 6 desktop workstation and versioned sample packs

quality.intent: Audio correctness, safe parameter handling, metadata integrity and reproducible verification.

criteria.requirement: Generator outputs respect the declared parameter and sample invariants.
criteria.verification: Native generator tests exercise the core output contract.

criteria.requirement: Pack metadata follows a versioned schema and malformed fixtures are rejected.
criteria.verification: The fixture validator checks generated pack content against the declared schema.

criteria.requirement: Project-level capabilities and constraints remain machine-readable and consistent.
criteria.verification: The project contract validator is run in CI.

multiplicity.intent: Repeated generation is reproducible, batch limits are explicit and partial failures are visible.

criteria.requirement: A fixed seed and parameter set produce repeatable generation output.
criteria.verification: Generator tests protect seeded and deterministic behavior.

criteria.requirement: Multi-sample batches define an upper bound, stable item order, cancellation and per-item results.
criteria.verification: The generator test suite is the acceptance target; the batch API is not yet marked complete.

criteria.requirement: Exported pack fixtures can be validated repeatedly without mutating the source assets.
criteria.verification: The fixture validator is part of the Python contract CI job.

native.intent: The native C++ generator remains authoritative and desktop integration follows platform conventions.

criteria.requirement: The generator core builds as a C++20 library independently of the desktop UI.
criteria.verification: The native-engine CI job configures, builds and tests the core library.

criteria.requirement: Qt 6 owns desktop presentation while generator behavior remains in the native core.
criteria.verification: Linux and Windows CI jobs build and test the desktop target when Qt is available.

criteria.requirement: Sample packs use a versioned metadata and file-format contract.
criteria.verification: Schema and generated-fixture validation protect the exported boundary.
